title: An outside MCP client buys one car, end to end
label: Recorded on 9 Nov 2026 · sandbox · not live

tools.name: about_counter
tools.description: Who the maker is, what she ships where, shipping cost, commissions and how payment works.

tools.name: search_counter
tools.description: Search the maker's listings by words (colour, year, body style, occasion) and max price.

tools.name: item_details
tools.description: Full listing: scale, size in mm, materials, paint, build hours, stock, photo and page URL.

tools.name: delivery_estimate
tools.description: Ship date and estimated delivery window to a US state (two-letter code). Pass need_by (a date or a weekday like Friday) to get a verdict: on time, possible, or too late.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Create an order awaiting the person's approval and get a PayPal approval link. One car: item_id + quantity (a whole number ≥ 1). Several different cars: items = [{item_id, quantity}] (then item_id/quantity are ignored). customer (optional) = {full_name, phone, email, address_line_1, address_line_2?, city, state, postal_code}; without it PayPal uses the address on the buyer's PayPal account. Pass the person's request in their own words as what_the_shopper_asked.

Customer.description: Who the order ships to, exactly as the person typed it.

email.description: Email for the PayPal receipt or invoice and tracking.
email.title: Email

address_line_1.description: Street address with the house number.
address_line_1.title: Address Line 1

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX. Must match the ZIP.
state.title: State

Customer.title: Customer

Item.description: One shelf car in a multi-car order.

item_id.description: A listing id from search_counter, e.g. sg-014.
item_id.title: Item Id

quantity.description: How many, a whole number of at least 1 (up to the stock).
quantity.title: Quantity

Item.title: Item

tools.name: quote_commission
tools.description: Exact price, volume discount, shipping, build time and delivery for made-to-order cars. cars = [{model, year (of the real car), body_colour, interior_colour, quantity (whole number ≥ 1), details?}].

model.description: Body style or a listing it's based on: fastback, coupe, convertible…
model.title: Model

year.description: The year of the real car it's modelled on, as the person said it (e.g. 1967).
year.title: Year

quantity.description: How many of this build, a whole number of at least 1.
quantity.title: Quantity

details.description: Anything extra: stripes, wheels, a plate (optional).
details.title: Details

tools.name: start_commission_checkout
tools.description: Create the made-to-order order after the person agreed to the quote. cars as in quote_commission. With customer = {full_name, phone, email, address_line_1, address_line_2?, city, state, postal_code} it becomes a PayPal invoice sent to their email: 50% deposit now, the balance before shipping. Without it, a one-time PayPal approval link for the full amount.

model.description: Body style or a listing it's based on: fastback, coupe, convertible…
model.title: Model

year.description: The year of the real car it's modelled on, as the person said it (e.g. 1967).
year.title: Year

quantity.description: How many of this build, a whole number of at least 1.
quantity.title: Quantity

details.description: Anything extra: stripes, wheels, a plate (optional).
details.title: Details

Customer.description: Who the order ships to, exactly as the person typed it.

email.description: Email for the PayPal receipt or invoice and tracking.
email.title: Email

address_line_1.description: Street address with the house number.
address_line_1.title: Address Line 1

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX. Must match the ZIP.
state.title: State

Customer.title: Customer

tools.name: leave_contact
tools.description: Pass the person's phone number and question to the maker; she calls them back.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Status of an order: awaiting_approval, paid, shipped (with tracking), cancelled.
